stories.title: Trump anuncia una tregua energética de carácter “inmediato” entre Rusia y Ucrania

en.title: Trump announces an energy truce of 'immediate' character between Russia and Ukraine
en.summary: Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have reached an agreement on an immediate energy ceasefire. Zelenski stated the announcement surprised him but expressed support for it.

stories.title: Trump anuncia una «tregua energética» entre Rusia y Ucrania y Zelenski se abre a convocar elecciones

en.title: Trump announces an 'energy truce' between Russia and Ukraine and Zelenski opens up to calling elections
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia. Zelenski previously stated willingness to call elections if Putin accepts a 60-day truce.

stories.title: Trump afirma que Rusia y Ucrania han alcanzado un "alto el fuego energético", pero Zelenski asegura no estar al corriente

en.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine have reached an 'energy ceasefire', but Zelenski says he is unaware
en.summary: Trump claimed Russia and Ukraine reached an energy ceasefire agreement. Zelenski indicated he was not informed of such an accord but would accept it if Russia agrees.

stories.title: Mertxe Aizpurua no repetirá como candidata de EH Bildu al Congreso el 29-N

en.title: Mertxe Aizpurua will not repeat as EH Bildu candidate to Congress on 29-N
en.summary: The current parliamentary spokesperson will not be a candidate for EH Bildu in the upcoming congressional elections, as she will soon retire.

stories.title: Podemos y ERC, «muy cerca» de un pacto en Cataluña al margen del Frente Amplio

en.title: Podemos and ERC, "very close" to a pact in Catalonia outside the Broad Front
en.summary: Podemos and the Republican Left of Catalonia are negotiating a potential agreement in the region, separate from broader leftist coalition discussions. The talks follow clarification that ERC's Gabriel Rufián will remain with his party.

stories.title: Mertxe Aizpurua no repetirá en la candidatura de Bildu después de siete años siendo la portavoz 'abertzale' en el Congreso

en.title: Mertxe Aizpurua will not repeat on Bildu's candidacy after seven years as the nationalist spokesperson in Congress
en.summary: Mertxe Aizpurua, who has served as the spokesperson for the Bildu party in Congress for seven years, will not be included in the party's next electoral list. Bildu will announce its candidates on October 16, with voting by members on October 17-18.

stories.title: Trump anuncia una tregua energética con “efecto inmediato” entre Ucrania y Rusia

en.title: Trump announces an energy truce with "immediate effect" between Ukraine and Russia
en.summary: Donald Trump has announced an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia that would take immediate effect. Trump has called on both leaders to honor the agreement.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que le van a operar de un nódulo en el pulmón en los próximos días

en.title: The Pope announces he will have surgery for a lung nodule in the coming days
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced that he will undergo surgery for a lung nodule discovered during a recent medical examination. The nodule is in early stage and well-located, with surgery planned at Gemelli Hospital and an expected hospitalization of approximately seven days.

stories.title: Zelenski propone a Rusia una tregua de ataques a instalaciones energéticas tras el pacto entre Trump y Putin

en.title: Zelenski proposes ceasefire on energy infrastructure attacks to Russia following Trump-Putin agreement
en.summary: Ukraine's president seeks genuine guarantees to reach agreements on halting attacks on energy facilities. The Kremlin dismisses the proposal as irrational.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que tiene un nódulo en un pulmón y va a ser operado

en.title: Pope announces he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery
en.summary: The pontiff revealed a nodule detected in an early stage requiring surgical intervention. He confirmed his planned trip to Latin America on November 6.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que deberá operarse de un nódulo en el pulmón en fase "muy inicial"

en.title: Pope announces surgery scheduled for lung nodule in early stage
en.summary: The pontiff will undergo surgical intervention in the coming days for a nodule detected at an initial stage, with one week of post-operative hospitalization expected.

stories.title: El papa León XIV anuncia que será operado de un nódulo en el pulmón

en.title: Pope Leo XIV announces he will undergo surgery for lung nodule
en.summary: The pontiff confirmed detection of a nodule in an early stage requiring surgical intervention within the coming days.

stories.title: Los hutíes demuestran su alcance militar con ataques mortales con misiles contra Riad

en.title: Houthis demonstrate military reach with deadly missile attacks against Riyadh
en.summary: Missile attacks that killed people at Riyadh's international airport last week have shown the growing military power of Yemeni Houthi rebels, who have evolved from an insurgency into one of the Middle East's most formidable non-state armed forces.

stories.title: Sánchez pide al Supremo frenar el "intento de atropello" de PP y Vox contra la ley de nietos

en.title: Sánchez asks Supreme Court to stop 'attempt to override' by PP and Vox against grandchildren's law
en.summary: Spain's government president and socialist election candidate Pedro Sánchez called on the Supreme Court to block what he described as an attempt by PP and Vox to override a law regarding voting rights, stating democracy guarantees rather than prohibits voting rights.

stories.title: Gabriel Rufián será el cabeza de cartel de ERC en las generales

en.title: Gabriel Rufián will be ERC's leading candidate in general elections
en.summary: Gabriel Rufián, current spokesperson for the separatist ERC party in Congress, will again lead the party's ticket for the general elections scheduled for November 29.

stories.title: Vox propone construir "masivamente" vivienda social y adjudicarla con "prioridad nacional"

en.title: Vox proposes building "massively" social housing and awarding it with "national priority"
en.summary: The general secretary of the Spanish political party Vox proposed constructing large quantities of social housing with allocation based on national priority, prioritizing Spanish citizens in housing allocation lists.

stories.title: Las diez innovaciones con las que Decathlon quiere hacer más accesible practicar deporte

en.title: Ten innovations with which Decathlon wants to make practicing sport more accessible
en.summary: Decathlon held its Innovation Awards 2026 in Lille, where ten teams presented proposals including shoes that measure cushioning wear and cycling gear with airbag technology. The competition showcased the industrial scale of the group, which has annual revenue of 16.8 billion euros.
